kernel: 2-D Kirchhoff time migration, zero-offset, constant velocity (Yilmaz 2001). z = 0.5 v t with the user velocity. No topography, no 3-D, not a measured depth model.

cases.name: known_diffraction_correct_velocity
cases.oracle: analytic zero-offset hyperbola t=sqrt(t0^2+x^2/v^2) at a known apex

cases.name: known_diffraction_half_velocity_diagnostic
cases.oracle: same hyperbola migrated at 0.5 v; must not earn the correct-velocity gate
cases.notes: Wrong-velocity imaging is recorded; it is not required to fail the location gate.

limitations: Benchmark is a noise-free constant-velocity zero-offset hyperbola.
Passing does not prove pipes, voids, archaeology, or a measured depth.
3-D migration, topography, and laterally varying velocity are not implemented.
